short_description:
Even if GTA VI wins all 8 categories it's nominated in at The Game Awards 2026, it can't break the record: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 won 9 awards in one night in 2025 (Guinness World Records). GTA VI's 8 nominations: Game of the Year, Best Game Direction, Best Narrative, Best Art Direction, Best Score and Music, Best Audio Design, Best Performance (Manni L. Perez as Lucia) and Best Action/Adventure. Our prediction: 6 of 8. The show is live Thursday, December 10 at 7:30 PM ET from the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles. How many will it win?

Sources: Guinness World Records, VGC, TechRadar, Wccftech, Billboard, VICE.
